jobs.description:
SALES ASSOCIATE 50-80% Basel - Swatch Group

SALES ASSOCIATE 50-80% Basel
The company
Swatch ist einer der führenden Schweizer Uhrenhersteller und gleichzeitig eine der weltweit berühmtesten Marken. Die ersten Swatch Uhren verblüfften ihr Publikum durch ein revolutionäres Konzept, kreatives Design und die Lust an der Provokation. Die Philosophie der Marke, die auf Farbe, Bewegung, Leichtigkeit und Transparenz basiert, ist in jedem Produkt und Projekt von Swatch deutlich zu erkennen. Die Marke bewahrt zudem eine starke Präsenz in der Welt des Sports und der Kunst.
Für unseren SWATCH Store in Basel suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n motivierte/n, engagierte/n und flexible/n
SALES ASSOCIATE 50-80%
Job description
Deine 
• Aufgaben:
Aktive Beratung und Verkauf unserer Produkte im Store (Swatch und Flik Flak)
Sicherstellung eines herzlichen Empfangs sowie eines zuvorkommenden Kundenservices
Attraktive Präsentation unserer Produkte im Store gemäss den visuellen Vorgaben
Verantwortung für die korrekte Bedienung und Abrechnung an der Kasse
Durchführung kleiner Servicearbeiten wie Batteriewechsel und Anpassungen von Uhrenarmbändern
Sicherstellung eines gepflegten und einladenden Erscheinungsbild des Stores
Entgegennahme von Lieferungen sowie Unterstützung bei der Warenbewirtschaftung
Profile
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Erfahrung im Verkauf, idealerweise im Bereich Uhren, Schmuck oder Lifestyle-Produkte
Flexibilität hinsichtlich Einsatzzeiten und Freude am lebendigen Store-Alltag
Professional requirements
Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und erfahrene/n, mehrsprachige/n Sales Associate, welche/r sich in einem dynamischen, internationalen Arbeitsumfeld mit grosser Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und Eigenverantwortung wohlfühlt.
Als Sales Associate bist du Teil unseres internationalen Teams, das exzellenten Kundenservice bietet, den Verkauf fördert und zum Erfolg unserer Swatch Stores beiträgt. Werde Teil unseres Teams und repräsentiere die Marke mit Begeisterung, Produktwissen und einer starken Kundenorientierung.
Languages
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch- sowie Französischkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

SWATCH Retail SA
Human Resources
Nicolas G. Hayek Strasse 1
CH - 2502 Biel/Bienne

4051 Basel

Swatch Ltd
CH-2502 Biel

Sales Operations Manager - Swatch Group

Sales Operations Manager
The company
The Sales Operations Manager is a key role within EM Microelectronic, reporting directly to the VP Sales & Marketing. This position acts as a strategic and operational bridge between the worldwide Sales & Marketing team and other core departments including Global Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations. The role supports executive decision-making by ensuring accurate data, streamlined processes, and proactive collaboration across functions.
This role does not offer any hybrid/remote work possibility.
Job description
Key
• Responsibilities
Sales Data Management & Reporting
Own and manage core sales data
Ensure consistency and quality of sales data across departments
Monitor performance, identify trends, and highlight areas for improvement
Sales Forecasting & Planning
Coordinate the global forecasting process with regional Sales Managers, Business Units, and Supply Chain
Use historical and current data to drive accurate short- and long-term sales projections
Support the definition of annual budgets and multi-year strategic planning
Cross-Functional Collaboration (S&OP)
Act as a strategic liaison between Sales, Finance, and Operations
Support Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to align demand and supply
Streamline cross-departmental communication and reduce duplicated efforts
Sales Tools, CRM & ERP Systems
Lead the implementation and optimization of ERP/CRM tools supporting sales processes
Ensure smooth integration and usability of systems, working closely with IT and external consultants
Pricing & Revenue Management
Prepare and deploy price list updates across platforms
Coordinate pricing consistency across teams and regions
Sales Enablement & Team Support
Provide operational and analytical support to the global sales team, enabling them to focus on customer engagement
Assist with transactional tasks, reporting, and the management of sales documents and contracts
Support onboarding and ongoing training initiatives related to tools and processes
Communication & Organizational Alignment
Facilitate structured communication across the sales team and executive leadership
Ensure clarity of goals, updates, and priorities across global stakeholders
Manage risk assessments and mitigation follow-ups related to sales execution
Profile
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and regions (Asia, Europe, Americas)
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Basic financial literacy, including familiarity with budgeting and margin analysis
Professional requirements
At least 5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or similar roles within the semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing industry.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large datasets
Business acumen: Understanding of sales processes, go-to-market strategy, and financial principles such as margin analysis, budgeting, and forecasting
Technical proficiency:
Advanced Excel and Power BI skills (e.g., pivot tables, data models, automated dashboards)
Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems (SAP, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics preferred)
Languages
Fluent in English (written and spoken)
Any other language (mainly french) would be an asset

LEARNING CONTENT DESIGNER 100%
The company
At Swatch, we thrive on surprise. Whether it’s with our collections, action sports or artistic collaborations, we don’t stay inside the box. We’re here to shake things up with our striking designs, which always reflect the zeitgeist but never fail to catch the eye. That’s what we do best, and that’s what we’ve done since 1983.

• Erstellen Sie Blended-Learning-Reisen, die digitale, virtuelle und persönliche Formate für den globalen Einsatz kombinieren.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Produkt-, Marketing- und Einzelhandelsteams zusammen, um die Genauigkeit der Inhalte, die Ausrichtung auf die Marke und die betriebliche Relevanz sicherzustellen.

International Creative Content Project Leader - Swatch Group

International Creative Content Project Leader
The company
Tissot has been growing and developing its tradition of innovation since 1853. From the early days to the present, in its home in Le Locle in the Swiss Jura mountains, Tissot has translated craftsmanship and precision into stylish timepieces now sold in over 160 countries around the world. Special materials, advanced functionality and meticulous design detail join forces to create the luxury of accessibility. Today Tissot is a member of the Swatch Group, the world’s largest watch producer and distributor of Swiss watches. The tradition of innovation lives on, keeping closely in touch with the times.
